requirement_snapshot.name: Tasks Area
requirement_snapshot.description: Display a tasks area section on the home page with a heading "Tasks".

interfaces.name: TasksSection
interfaces.responsibility: Renders the Tasks area section on the home page with the visible heading "Tasks" and an explicit empty state.
interfaces.specification: Renders a <section aria-labelledby="tasks-heading"> containing an <h2 id="tasks-heading"> with exact text "Tasks"; no task data is owned, so it shows an empty-state note.
interfaces.outputs: section element with heading Tasks and empty-state text
interfaces.test_focus: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Tasks' }) and section labelled by it are present; renders empty state without fabricated rows

interfaces.name: HomePage
interfaces.responsibility: Home page entry surface, additively extended to mount TasksSection inside its content container.
interfaces.specification: Imports and mounts TasksSection inside the main content wrapper; App.tsx route registration for HomePage is untouched.
interfaces.outputs: main element containing the Tasks section
interfaces.test_focus: Rendering HomePage shows the Tasks heading; existing home page mount point remains intact
